level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## 2026.11.3

### Highlights

- **Private task results:** Keep private subagent completions out of streamed chat replies. (#188490) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Reliable child-task handoffs:** Allow a parent to hand off to replacement work after cancelling a child, without leaving the cancelled child's completion receipt blocking the handoff. (#178893; related #178565) Thanks @brianmcguire and @letsc4.
- **Visible tool failures:** Report unanswered tool failures instead of silently ending a user-addressed turn as a success. (#182458; related #99645) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @rdleclerc.
- **Bounded authentication:** Stop stalled provider authentication at the run deadline and propagate cancellation through authentication work. (#189144) Thanks @amittell.
- **Sandboxed image access:** Keep required-sandbox image previews inside allowed folders, even in Full Access mode, while preserving explicit administrator image allowances. (#176203) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **Verified workspace connections:** Preserve saved node certificate pins when an empty fingerprint is supplied, and verify workspace-transfer certificates before sending credentials or data. (#125646, #190002) Thanks @wanyongstar and @avelev99.
- **Faster, responsive Gateway:** Reduce startup module-file loading overhead and avoid stalls when abort-command detection encounters long punctuation runs. (#192217, #184433) Thanks @karkarl, @RomneyDa, @LeizhenZhang, and @obviyus.

### Changes

No new configuration options or features.

### Fixes

- **Credential isolation:** Keep reused and cached plugin results scoped to their connection credentials, and keep other plugins' transport hooks on the provider's origin. (#178444, #177974, #189423) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
- **Search and memory credentials:** Keep Firecrawl search and scrape keys with their scoped endpoints and embedding credentials with their destination. (#190706, #184966) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt and @eleqtrizit.
- **Credential redaction:** Redact inline environment credentials from configuration reads and reflected search credentials from Exa errors. (#190618, #178745) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yetval.
- **Child-process environments:** Prevent managed Signal daemons and bundled language servers from inheriting unrelated Gateway secrets. (#179198, #179415) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Authentication errors:** Surface credential-read failures rather than treating them as missing credentials, and reject explicitly selected auth p

level1_releases.body_excerpt:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.1

**Release Date:** November 9, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~618 PRs merged since v0.23.0 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

**What this patch ships for plugin users:** since the plugin catalog's site deploy on November 9, the published `plugin-catalog.json` was larger than the 2 MiB cap clients accept, so every install silently fell back to the catalog it shipped with. `hermes plugins install <name>` could not find plugins added since your last update, installed the pin your release shipped instead of the current one, and missed newer `removed` entries. This release raises the cap to 16 MiB, so the live catalog is used again ([#151860](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/151860), fixes [#151856](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues/151856), thanks @100yenadmin). Installs that stay on v0.23.0 or older keep falling back until they update.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `3b421578588`, the window since v0.23.0 contains **2,578 non-merge commits** across **2,781 changed files** (+151,690 / −62,595), **618 merged PRs** and **409 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: Esc backtrack in the TUI and classic CLI (replacing the rewind list picker), group chats that run on a gateway without Desktop and can seat bots from other computers, saved gateway connections shared by Desktop and the Webapp, signing the in-app browser in with your real browser profile and filling saved logins from its address bar, `hermes gateway attach` for local clients, `hermes clipboard image --json`, new plugin API (session-scoped environment values, plugin JSON-RPC methods and events, `llm.oneshot` auxiliary tasks, a compression-stable `conversation_id`, an `on_session_open` hook in the gateway, a `post_curator_run` hook), faster transcript and handoff reads, and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.
